title: Yelp Combines Native and Server-Driven UI for Its AI Assistant
gist: Yelp built its AI Assistant on a hybrid UI, keeping navigation and message input native while rendering the conversation via its server-driven CHAOS framework, so changes ship without app releases. The event-driven split of view configuration from conversation data enabled reuse for the Biz Ask Anything pilot and its next-generation Assistant, at the cost of coordination and cross-platform inconsistency.

insights.claim: Yelp's AI Assistant combines native mobile navigation and message input with conversation content rendered by Yelp's server-driven CHAOS framework, allowing interface changes to reach users without a new mobile app release.
insights.speaker: Leela Kumili
insights.so_what: Server-driven UI lets consumer apps iterate AI features faster than app-store release cycles allow.
